skill_entry.name: 8. Result rows, body sentences and the branch state match the reviewed head
skill_entry.trigger: Any one: (a) the body reports a measurement of the PR's code (test counts, token identity, perf A/B, objdump, lint, build) under a Verification, Status, Tests or Results heading; (b) a non-merge commit by the PR author inside BASE..HEAD has a committer date after the body's last edit (createdAt when the body was never edited), or its subject contains 'review round', 'review feedback', 'Apply suggestions from code review' or 'Integrate review'; (c) `gh pr view N --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus` answers CONFLICTING or DIRTY at the head being approved; (d) the body says a file is ported, copied, extracted, cherry-picked or originally authored from a named branch or PR; (e) a push arrives while an inline thread the reviewer himself opened holds an unresolved suggestion block.
skill_entry.procedure: Resolve BASEREF, BASEOID and HEAD first; BASE = merge-base HEAD BASEOID, never origin/main. Result rows: hex ids containing a letter in those sections; cat-file, is-ancestor against HEAD, gh commits (404 or 422 = twin); per ancestor list the PR files changed since; verdict per row. Body: LAST = the last body edit before the review being written; list the author's non-merge commits after LAST; for each body sentence whose symbol, key or count one of those commits touched (git log -S), grep the identifier the commit subject names at HEAD and count TEST_CASE in the named test file. Branch: gh mergeable live; merge-tree conflict markers for a posted review. Ported file: diff the PR copy against the source head dated at the review; a symbol only in the PR copy that a source commit removed is the finding. Suggestion: grep the thread's original line text at HEAD.
skill_entry.question: Does the description, including every result id and every mechanism sentence the review-round commits touched, describe this head; does this head merge into its target branch as it stands; does a ported file match its source branch head; and is every suggestion thread the reviewer opened applied at this push?
skill_entry.do_not_fire: Ids in a commit or review-outcome table; the target-branch baseline id; reference bands from outside the PR. A row with no id when no commit postdates the body's last edit (PR 2475). A body edited after the last code commit, an empty body, or a sentence no post-edit commit touched (a never-true claim is check 6). BEHIND, or a target tip that is not an ancestor of HEAD, with a clean merge-tree (19 of 36 silent tron PRs). A ported copy that lacks source symbols: first-step merge (PR 1707), extraction (PR 2844), cherry-pick plus own changes (PR 2875); a difference the body states as held back (PR 2676, POS_PER_PAGE); 'ported' inside 'reported'. Commit count (PR 4596 approved at 26). Follow-ups the author agreed to. A bot's resolved suggestion thread. Whether the rebase or refresh happened afterwards.
skill_entry.finding_shape: Result row: 'PR description, <section>: the <kind> rows cite <id>, <event>; <files> changed since then. Please <re-run at <HEAD> | delete them, the rows at <HEAD> replace them | mark them pre-merge and say which files did not change>.' Stale body at approval (absorbs the result rows; not blocking): 'I think your PR description is stale at this point: it says <clause>, but at <HEAD> <symbol or count> is <value> (<commit>). Please refresh it; also you currently have a merge conflict.' Ported file: 'this is an old version. <path> still declares <symbols> that <source> dropped in <commit>. Be sure you are rebased to latest <source>.' Unapplied suggestion, as a reply in the thread: 'looks like this still needs fixed'.
skill_entry.severity_wade_uses: Result-row provenance: a plain ask inside a COMMENTED review ('Please re-run them or mark them as pre-merge', 5420005787), no severity word. Stale body and merge conflict: one sentence of the approval, next to 'But overall looks good' (5371062950). Rebase ask: inside an approval, 'Also needs rebased' (4373886636). Never a block: 0 CHANGES_REQUESTED in 334 reviews. Ported file older than its source: a COMMENTED review at 36cf204564 (4249324314, 03:39Z), then APPROVED at b7ac03113f sixteen hours later (4254812986, 19:31Z). Unapplied suggestion: a four-word reply in his own thread (3002050036), nit level.
skill_entry.evidence_scope: PR body text and its edit history (userContentEdits, each diff field is the full body after that edit); commits in BASE..HEAD (author, committer date, subject, parents); the ported file on its source branch at the review time; this PR's review threads (suggestion blocks, isResolved); gh mergeable state, or a read-only merge-tree for a posted review. GitHub contents API for commits the worktree lacks. Not CI, not runtime.

final.procedure_commands:
## Check 8: result rows, body sentences and the branch state match the reviewed head

Setup for this check (replaces `BASE=$(git -C WT merge-base $HEAD origin/main)` for every check):
```
read BASEREF BASEOID HEADOID < <(gh pr view N --repo positron-ai/tron --json baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid -q '[.baseRefName,.baseRefOid,.headRefOid]|@tsv')
HEAD=<the reviewed head; $HEADOID for a live review>
BASE=$(git -C WT merge-base $HEAD $BASEOID)
```
After a merge, `merge-base HEAD origin/main` returns HEAD itself (PR 4596: 441e81178b, 0 commits, 0 files); baseRefOid is the target-branch commit GitHub compared against and stays correct (66c7bb8db1, 26 non-merge commits, 11 files). PR 2233 targeted hwattention_sync; never hard-code origin/main.

1. Live state: `gh pr view N --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus,state,mergedAt`.
2. Section ranges: headings whose text contains Verification, Status, Tests or Results, ending at the next heading of the same or higher level.
3. Ids: `grep -oE '\b[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b' body.md | grep -E '[a-f]' | sort -u`, restricted to measurement rows in those sections; drop hits inside fenced code blocks and JSON samples (PR 4596 live body: 23 of 32 raw hits are decimal counter values). A row without an id takes the nearest "Binary:" or "at <id>" line of its section; a section with no id at all and no commit newer than the body's last edit (step 7) describes HEAD and is accepted (PR 2475).
4. Per id: `git -C WT cat-file -t ID`; `git -C WT merge-base --is-ancestor ID $HEAD`; `gh api repos/positron-ai/tron/commits/ID --jq .sha` (404 or 422 = GitHub cannot show it). Not resolving or not an ancestor = twin -> finding, unless the body itself states the difference ("ebadce2adb as f7da0e64ab, which differs by one comment line": accepted). A twin's dates give the event: `gh api repos/positron-ai/tron/commits/ID --jq '.commit.author.date, .commit.committer.date'` equal to HEAD's author date = amend or rebase of the same commit. Invent no further history.
5. Per ancestor id: `git -C WT rev-list --count --first-parent ID..$HEAD`; `git -C WT rev-list --parents ID..$HEAD | awk 'NF>2'` (a two-parent commit = merge of the target branch); `for f in $(cat prfiles.txt); do git -C WT diff --quiet ID $HEAD -- $f || echo $f; done`.
6. Row verdict: id == HEAD -> fine; id behind with no label -> finding; a label with the unchanged PR files, the re-run date or a stated difference -> accepted. A present-tense phrase ("ran at the head X", "now", "current") next to a non-HEAD id -> finding. Ask per kind: unit tests, token identity, lint, build -> re-run at HEAD, or delete when rows at HEAD already stand, or label; perf A/B and objdump -> add the id and a label, never a re-run. At approval, when step 8 reports at least one stale sentence, the result rows go into the one stale-body sentence; post no separate re-run ask (PR 4596: the 2026-09-25 Verification rows cite ebadce2adb, 0274131d23, 7f8a4aa4d8, d85edc0e28, 16 to 19 commits behind 441e81178b with 10 of 11 PR files changed, and Wade asked for no re-run).
7. Body edit times: `gh api graphql -f query='{repository(owner:"positron-ai",name:"tron"){pullRequest(number:N){createdAt lastEditedAt userContentEdits(first:50){nodes{editedAt editor{login} diff}}}}}' > edits.json`. Each `diff` field is the full body text after that edit, not a patch. Live review: LAST = lastEditedAt (createdAt when userContentEdits is empty) and body.md = the live text. Review already posted: LAST = the newest editedAt before the review time, and body.md = that edit's `diff` (PR 4596: the 2026-09-25T22:31:45Z text, 13078 chars; the live text is the 2026-10-01 refresh and holds nothing stale). Commits: `git -C WT log --no-merges --author='<PR author>' --format='%h %cI %s' --since=LAST $BASE..$HEAD` (ISO time with Z works; PR 4596: 16 commits, 12 subjects contain "review round"). An empty body, a body with no mechanism sentence, or zero commits -> skip steps 8a and 8b.
8a. Mechanism sentences: `grep -nE '[0-9]+ (cases|tests|assertions)|keyed by|per (pool |attention )?(worker|layer|forward)|owns|T[1-9] =' body.md | grep -v '^[0-9]*:[ ]*[\[{"]'` (PR 4596 2026-09-25 body: 7 sentence lines, 0 JSON lines). Keep only sentences whose symbol, key or count a step-7 commit touched: `git -C WT log --format=%h -S'<identifier>' --since=LAST $BASE..$HEAD` non-empty, or the commit changes the named test file; the rest is check 6 territory. For a kept sentence take the identifier from the commit subject, not the body phrase: `git -C WT grep -n '<identifier>' $HEAD -- h src t` (at 441e81178b `attention worker` has 17 comment hits and decides nothing; `pool_worker` has 2 hits, attn_stats.hpp:336 and :431, from bff317e0d3 'rows keyed by pool worker', review round 4, W5). Counts: `git -C WT show $HEAD:<test file> | grep -c '^TEST_CASE'` (12 at 1430736b2a, 17 at 441e81178b, 18 at 0f784c44ff).
8b. Sample keys: `grep -o '"[a-z_0-9]*":' body.md | tr -d '":' | sort -u`; strip a `ready_` or `pending_` prefix and a `_w0` suffix to get the stem; `git -C WT grep -c -F '<stem>' $HEAD -- <renderer>`. Only a stem with 0 hits is a finding: the renderer escapes keys inside fmt::format strings (`\"key\"`) and composes the visit counters from prefix and stem (PR 4596: a literal grep of the full key reads 13 of 39 keys as absent although all exist at run time). A sample value the review itself flags as from a stale configuration (`"join_wait_cycles":0` from the untimed poll, inline 4125033634) is a stale-sample finding regardless of the grep.
9. Branch state. Live: step 1; CONFLICTING or DIRTY = "merge conflict"; UNKNOWN = re-query once after 10 s. A review already posted, or any merged PR: gh answers UNKNOWN for good; use the read-only `git -C WT merge-tree $BASE $HEAD $BASEOID > mt.txt; grep -c '<<<<<<<' mt.txt` (unanchored: the old merge-tree prints `+<<<<<<< .our`); the `changed in both` header above the first marker names the file (PR 4596 at 441e81178b vs 9b60b69dce: 1 block, h/tron/models/model.hpp, resolved by the two-parent merge 8c95514924 four hours after the approval). BEHIND, or a target tip not an ancestor of HEAD, is never a finding (19 of 36 silent tron PRs, 0 conflict markers each). Never run `merge-tree --write-tree` or `merge` in a read-only worktree. Report as one clause of the review body, never as a block.
10. Ported files: `grep -nEiw 'ported|copied|extracted|cherry-pick|cherry-picked|originally authored' body.md; grep -nEi 'from `?[A-Za-z_/-]+`? branch' body.md` (bare `ported` matched 'reported' on PRs 4256 and 4353). Without a named source branch or PR, write Insufficient data and stop (PR 1722 names none). Per file, source head at the review: `git -C WT log -1 --before='<review time>' --format='%h %cI %s' origin/S -- <path>` (PR 2676: a02939c11a 2026-05-05, not today's b4e9be991a 2026-05-14; drop --before for a live review). PR copy: `git -C WT show <id>:<path>` when the id resolves, else `gh api "repos/positron-ai/tron/contents/<path>?ref=<id>" --jq .content | base64 -d` (36cf204564 is not in the worktree, GitHub serves it, 184 lines). Symbols only in the PR copy: `diff <(git -C WT show <source>:<path>) <prcopy> | grep '^>' | grep -oE '\b[a-z_]+\(' | tr -d '(' | sort -u`; per symbol `git -C WT log -1 --before='<review time>' --format="$s %h %cI %s" -S"$s" origin/S -- <path>`; report only symbols whose last source commit removed them (PR 2676: gof_configure, gof_configured, gof_layer_uses_hw, gof_max_layers, gof_reset, gof_hw_params, removed by a02939c11a). A symbol the PR copy lacks is never a finding (PRs 1707, 2844, 2875). Drop differences the body states as held back.
11. Open suggestion threads at a new push: `gh api repos/positron-ai/tron/pulls/N/comments --paginate --jq '.[] | select(.body | test("```suggestion")) | [.id, .user.login, .path, .original_commit_id[0:10], .original_line, .commit_id[0:10], .line, (.body | split("\n")[1])] | @tsv'`; keep threads the reviewer opened and `gh api graphql` reviewThreads.isResolved false. Original line: `git -C WT show <original_commit_id>:<path> 2>/dev/null || gh api "repos/positron-ai/tron/contents/<path>?ref=<original_commit_id>" --jq .content | base64 -d`, then `sed -n '<original_line>p'`; grep that text in `git -C WT show $HEAD:<path>`; a hit = still unapplied -> reply in that thread. A comment whose `line` is null is outdated by a later push; still test its original text at the new head.

On PR 4596 (approved head 441e81178b, target main, BASE 66c7bb8db1): body edits 2026-09-24T19:46:11Z, 19:56:51Z, 2026-09-25T21:47:56Z, 22:11:19Z, 22:13:14Z, 22:31:45Z, then 2026-10-01T00:29:29Z (after approval); 16 non-merge jhan commits after the last pre-approval edit, 1430736b2a (2026-09-25 22:37 -0700) to 441e81178b (2026-09-30 10:57 -0700), twelve of them with "review round" in the subject (grep -c on the 16 subjects); stale sentences in the 2026-09-25 body: "per attention worker" (rows keyed by pool worker since bff317e0d3; helper pool_worker at h/tron/models/attn_stats.hpp:431, comment at :336), "12 cases" (t/t_attn_stats.cpp has 17 TEST_CASE at 441e81178b, 18 at 0f784c44ff), T5 "the join's wait loop" (software-only join timed since 6e23101744; self_attention.hpp:1283 `join_wait_cycles += rdtsc() - t_poll`), sample "join_wait_cycles":0 (from the untimed poll, inline 4125033634); live gh answers mergeable UNKNOWN; merge-tree 66c7bb8db1 441e81178b 9b60b69dce gives 1 conflict block in h/tron/models/model.hpp; the conflict was resolved by the two-parent merge 8c95514924 (parents 441e81178b, 9b60b69dce) at 2026-09-30 23:45Z, four hours after the 19:34Z approval; Wade's text: "I think your PR description is stale at this point (after all the updates from reviews), and you currently have a merge conflict."

residual_risks: Each of the four widened parts rests on one attested Wade instance (5371062950, 4373886636, 3206111074, 3002050036); the silent corpus shows no counter-example after narrowing, but one instance cannot show how often he applies the check.

Wade's 'stale' verdict on PR 4596 names no sentence; the three stale clauses (attention worker, 12 cases, T5 scope) are reconstructed from the body edit diff and the review-round commits. Which clause he read is unknown.

Whether PR 2766 conflicted at approval is Insufficient data: cef0fb5b64 is not in the worktree and gh reports only today's CONFLICTING/DIRTY state; 'needs rebased' may have meant 'behind' there, which the narrowed rule would not fire on.
The unapplied-suggestion step rests on one typo thread; whether he re-checks non-typo suggestion threads at every push is not measurable (no other unresolved thread of his was re-raised).

Step 8b (sample keys by stem) was tuned on one renderer (attn_stats.hpp); a renderer that builds keys differently may still read live keys as absent, so a 0-hit stem should be confirmed by reading the renderer before it is reported.
Step 10 needs read access to the source branch; a source in another repository, or a source PR whose head is not fetched (PR 2844's f90c80934 is not in WT), is Insufficient data.

The merge-tree substitute uses the old three-argument form; a newer git in the worktree may print markers in a different shape, so the grep count should be sanity-checked against the 'changed in both' headers.

The committer-date filter in trigger (b) fires on a plain rebase of an old commit (PR 3756); step 8's touched-symbol filter then yields no finding, so the cost is one extra git log, not a false finding.
